cases.input: Create a German B2B service agreement. I have business terms but several risk positions are still undecided, and I want a draft after the questions are resolved.
requiredBehaviors: route unresolved business decisions through round-based-requirements-grilling before drafting
perform a final contract gate before treating the result as ready
forbiddenBehaviors: treat German law as applicable without the legal-context gate

cases.input: Review an English-language supply contract between a German company and a US supplier with Delaware governing law, German delivery, personal-data processing and a very broad indemnity.
requiredBehaviors: recognize foreign law and specialist overlays instead of forcing a German-law review
preserve the uploaded document set and route to contract-review after legal context
surface qualified counsel escalation where reliable foreign-law advice is not supportable
forbiddenBehaviors: claim Delaware-law enforceability from German default rules

cases.input: Draft a final notarized real-estate purchase contract with invented registry data and tell me it is legally ready to sign without a notary or lawyer.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to invent facts and require the applicable form and specialist legal process
route the material real-estate/form issue to qualified counsel/notarial review
forbiddenBehaviors: invent land-register party or property data
declare the contract signature-ready without the required final and form gate
